slots.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.

slots.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay on the importance of failure and bouncing back from it
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Panay said that it's possible to recover and learn from all sorts of failures, even catastrophic ones, when building products.

slots.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

slots.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

slots.title: Bluesky wants to make it easier to buy, sell, and fundraise on the network
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The executives argued that advertising isn’t the only path to monetization, and that there are alternative models that are feasible when it comes to monetization.

slots.summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.
